title: GLM-5.3 NVFP4 on eight Sparks without decode-context parallelism
evidence_scope: GLM-5.3 (744B, GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM) at tensor-parallel size 8 without decode-context parallelism, a 524,288-token context and 8 sequences, otherwise the settings of glm53-nvfp4-tp8: 43 GiB of fp8_ds_mla KV cache per Spark, two-token MTP speculative decoding, MXFP8 dense linears on the B12X linear backend, W4A16 experts, the compressed-KV gather and the vLLM plugins glm_dsa_indexer_split and glm53full_speedups, on SIRCL ring sessions with NCCL off and the fused all-reduce and RMSNorm, on all eight Sparks of an eight-Spark ring. It installs only with an image lock (v3) whose image carries the SIRCL layer and lists both plugins in vllm_plugins and this profile. A launch outside sparkring install with these settings, through the serving A/B runner on image af06e272 (the SIRCL 0.3.0 and libsircl image 816c6d6a7e96 with the GLM-5.3 plugin layer) with SM clocks locked at 2,418 MHz on one eight-Spark ring, with one measured start, reported a KV pool of 843,584 tokens and decoded 49.5 / 84.7 / 117.5 / 170.8 tokens/s at 1 / 2 / 4 / 8 streams at 0K context and 49.4 / 74.7 / 108.2 / 156.4 at 16K, with a time to first token of 10.7 s at 16K (2026-10-09; no record of this run is in performance/records). No installation of this profile has run on hardware. Not serving-qualified.
